title: Chain events alert — 2026-11-21
body: **Nvidia aftermath (reported Nov 17; reaction through the Nov 20 close).** NVDA beat on Nov 17 (Q3 revenue $115.8B, +103% y/y; Q4 guide $130B ±3%), but fell 14.0% on Friday to $125.53 — -40.9% on the month and -47.5% below its 52-week high (collector, Nov 20 close) — on press reports of an SEC accounting probe. The semis sleeve took the blow: AVGO -12.2%, AMD -13.3%, MU -13.9% on Friday; the SOX posted its worst week since 2001 (NAI500). Infrastructure read-through: Vertiv -10.1%, SMCI -9.2% (Nov 20 close). **Next chain test:** Dell's Q3, week of Nov 24, after the U.S. close (late evening Berlin time; exact slot per issuer — not yet verified). Power/utilities stayed defensive — DUK +0.7%, XEL -0.2% on Friday — while CEG -5.8% and VST -7.2% still trade as AI beta. **Macro:** nothing scheduled until Nov payrolls Dec 4 (14:30 Berlin) and the Dec 9 FOMC (20:00 Berlin) with a hike nearly fully priced — the 40-60% exposure band and cash sleeve remain the posture.
